parameters.name: IstioVersion
parameters.description: The Istio version that the service mesh uses.

parameters.name: Kind
parameters.description:
The type of Istio resource for which you want to obtain common templates. Valid values:

- AuthorizationPolicy

- RequestAuthentication

- PeerAuthentication

- WorkloadGroup

- WorkloadEntry

- Sidecar

- EnvoyFilter

- ServiceEntry

- Gateway

- DestinationRule

- VirtualService
